purpose: Record the clean MAME replay that joins the lower-tower route to the established far-rope frontier.
confirmed: The correct continuation from the lower tower reverses left to the staircase ledge at world (2271,832), then crosses right through the tower band.
The crossing reaches the far lower floor at world x≈3315 without changing SCENE_STATE=0x01.
The initial close guard must be attacked immediately from the tower-cross endpoint; waiting at the loaded state allows the overlapping enemy to kill the player.
The second guard at x≈3627 and the far guard at x≈4704 are cleared by the recorded downward sword branches and become cleanup type 0x84 actors.
At the far rope, a C+Left jump reaches the behavior-0x22 contact window at (4721,816); pressing Up from that boundary locks the player to x=4728 and climbs to the behavior-0x24 top at (4728,671).
negative_evidence: The route does not yet satisfy the natural exit Y condition; the rope-top transfer to world Y<0x01D6 remains unresolved.
conclusion: The newly recovered lower route and the earlier far-rope route are now one reproducible, checkpointed path. Future work should branch from rope-top and focus on the upper-band transfer/exit interaction rather than re-testing the lower tower.
